He holds a large red and black toy baseball bat, demonstrating a batting stance to the camera. The background shows several rows of black chairs in an adjacent room and another person sitting distantly. (2) He moves the bat to various positions, pointing to the handle and the barrel to illustrate hitting angles. He shifts his hands and arms, demonstrating the difference between a high 'lead hand' and a tucked-in hand. His facial expressions are focused and instructional as he talks directly toward the camera. (3) He performs several slow-motion swing trajectories, showing how the bat's path should extend upward rather than chopping downward. He occasionally touches his head to signal a starting point for the swing. The camera remains at eye-level with slight handheld movement, and the lighting is bright and consistent across the indoor scene.
